project: Test Drive 6 - Here In My Recomp
approach: Static recompilation of TD6.exe to C, with a Windows and DirectX 7 stand-in on SDL3 and Vulkan; checked frame by frame against the original code.
help: Trying the Windows download on a real Windows PC
Testing on other computers and controllers
notes: Alpha: every front-end screen and race mode works, but only the author's own Linux computer has played it. The Windows download has only been checked under Wine, not yet on a Windows PC, and its first-run build step is untested. Bring your own copy; the download checks it and builds the game on your computer. Adds any resolution, widescreen, correct speed at high refresh rates, and controllers with rumble.
